RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying the identical request.

CompanyIdempotencyKey.description: Stable key. After an uncertain response retry the identical body and key; use a new key for a new intended operation.
CompanyIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

CompanyIncludeValidationDetails.description: Send `true` to add `validationErrors` to a failed publishing check. No other query parameter is accepted.
CompanyIncludeValidationDetails.name: includeValidationDetails

CompanyWebhookId.description: Exact subscription ID from this Workspace webhook list.
CompanyWebhookId.name: webhookId

CompanyWorkspaceId.description: Exact accessible Company Workspace ID returned by Company context.
CompanyWorkspaceId.name: X-Publora-Workspace-Id

XPubloraClient.description: Optional client identifier accepted by every API-key-authenticated operation. Any non-empty value is preserved; `api` is used when absent. Setting `mcp` triggers the MCP access entitlement check.
XPubloraClient.name: x-publora-client

CompanyAccessDenied.description: AGENCY_CORE_ACCESS_DENIED: the Workspace header is missing or invalid, the Workspace is not accessible, the role lacks the capability or the Account is not an Agency. Refusals of the API key itself (API_ACCESS_REQUIRED, MCP_ACCESS_REQUIRED, USER_INACTIVE) use the API-key envelope.

CompanyApprovalInvalid.description: COMPANY_APPROVAL_INVALID: invalid body, or a missing, malformed or inaccessible post group ID (approval operations return 400 instead of 404). AGENCY_CORE_CONTENT_INPUT_INVALID: missing or invalid Idempotency-Key on a keyed command.

CompanyApprovalUnavailable.description: COMPANY_APPROVAL_UNAVAILABLE, AGENCY_CORE_CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE or AGENCY_CORE_CONTENT_GRAPH_INVALID. Retry the identical request later.

CompanyAuthenticationFailed.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key, in the API-key envelope `{error, code?}`. Repeated failures for one key return 429 API_KEY_AUTH_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

CompanyConflict.description: Content or media state conflict, or AGENCY_CORE_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT / AGENCY_CORE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Refetch before sending a changed request; for an in-flight request wait Retry-After and resend the identical body and key.

CompanyContextUnavailable.description: AGENCY_CORE_C2_UNAVAILABLE: every context failure, including an unknown or inaccessible Workspace. Re-read `/company/contexts/v2` or retry later.

CompanyMediaMismatch.description: AGENCY_CORE_MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH: invalid body or Idempotency-Key, unsupported type, or uploaded bytes that do not match the reservation; AGENCY_CORE_MEDIA_SIZE_EXCEEDED: file size above the limit. Media commands have no 400.

CompanyResourceNotFound.description: Post or media does not exist in the selected Workspace.

CompanyScheduleInvalid.description: AGENCY_CORE_CONTENT_INPUT_INVALID: invalid body, time, query or Idempotency-Key, or the draft fails a publishing check (channels, ready media, client approval, platform rules). With `includeValidationDetails=true`, `validationErrors` lists the failed checks.

advisory.description: Always true; the snapshot reserves nothing

allowedPlatforms.description: Platform types the plan allows; null means all platforms

effectiveQuotaTime.description: The date used to select the monthly quota period

analytics.description: Needed by the Mastodon and Bluesky statistics endpoints

mentionables.description: Needed by the LinkedIn mentionables endpoint

connections.description: Per-connection usage when scope is connection; otherwise empty

maxScheduledDate.description: Latest time a post can be scheduled; null when there is no horizon

remaining.description: null when unlimited, or when scope is connection (read connections[])

scope.description: `account`: one shared limit. `connection`: a separate limit for each connection.

CompanyAccountBilling.description: Agency billing state. With `payment_required`, Company mutations except unscheduling return 402 COMPANY_BILLING_REQUIRED.

expiresAt.description: The review page expires 30 days after the request.

notificationStatus.description: Delivery of the decision email to the user who requested the review.

publication.description: Present only when the review was requested with a `scheduledTime`.

reviewUrl.description: Private review page for the client. Publora does not send it: deliver it yourself, treat it as a bearer credential and keep it out of logs.

notificationStatus.description: `sending` means another attempt is in progress; try again after a few minutes.

canRequestApproval.description: True for a draft when the caller can request reviews. Otherwise false, and `reviewUrl` is null.

managerComment.description: Optional note shown to the client.

scheduledTime.description: Optional future UTC time with exactly three fractional digits. When set, the client's approval schedules this exact version; do not schedule it again. If the time passes before the decision, the approved post stays a draft.

CompanyAuthError.description: API-key authentication envelope shared with the personal API; it is not the Company domain error envelope. Coded refusals add `code`, for example API_ACCESS_REQUIRED, MCP_ACCESS_REQUIRED, USER_INACTIVE or API_KEY_AUTH_RATE_LIMITED.

CompanyCommandResult.description: `applied` for a new command, `replayed` for an identical retry with the same Idempotency-Key. A replay returns the original result and the same status code.

activationStatus.description: Present only while the channel waits for billing activation; it cannot be scheduled yet.

externalOwners.description: Present only for channels attributed to a trusted integration.

items.description: All publishing channels of the Workspace, oldest first; not paginated.

CompanyContextAccount.description: `billing` is present only for `kind: agency`. Company content endpoints work only in Agency Workspaces; Corporate accounts (`kind: team`, `presentationMode: people`) list no Workspaces.

workspaces.description: Default Workspace first. Always empty for Corporate accounts.

defaultContext.description: Set only when exactly one Account/Workspace pair exists.

firstComment.description: One first comment under supported own posts. null clears; firstComments arrays and delays remain personal-only.

isPlatformSpecific.description: If supplied, sameContent is also required and must have the opposite value.

platforms.description: Exact Company channel keys `<platform>-<platformId>` from `/company/connections`; [] permits a channel-less draft.

repostSourceSnapshot.description: Original LinkedIn post saved as the review preview of a Company Page reshare; it must match the enabled LinkedIn repost target. null clears.

deletionAfter.description: Storage cleanup runs after this time.

youtubeThumbnail.description: Present only when a YouTube thumbnail is selected.

fileName.description: No control characters or surrounding whitespace.

purpose.description: Omit for ordinary media. Auxiliary thumbnails require JPEG/PNG, type image, at most 2097152 bytes and at least 640x360 actual pixels.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte count of the upload. At most 100 MiB for images and documents and 512 MiB for video.

uploadHeaders.description: Send every header exactly, plus Content-Length equal to `sizeBytes`.

CompanyPlatformSettings.description: Agency platform settings; discover the available formats and settings through GET /company/platforms. This complete map replaces saved settings; only selected platforms may carry entries.

A non-fatal notice about a request that still succeeded. The `warnings`
array is only present when at least one warning applies — the key is
omitted, not empty, otherwise.

Treat `code` as the contract: `message` is human-readable and may change
at any time. Which fields accompany `code` depends on the code itself.

- `FIRST_COMMENT_PLATFORM_NOT_TARGETED` — `firstComment.platforms`

  ignored. Carries `platforms`.
- `FIRST_COMMENT_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORMS` — some targets are on
  platforms without first-comment support; the comment is skipped

schedule with a 503 `MediaPendingError` instead.

post.description:
Attach one image or video to an existing draft or scheduled post using a
file reference: an HTTPS download URL plus a stable file ID, the shape
ChatGPT supplies through `openai/fileParams` to the MCP `attach_media`
tool. Publora downloads the file right away through the same guarded
pipeline as `mediaUrls`, which detects the type from the bytes and probes
the file. Accepted: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, TIFF and AVIF images up to 25 MB;
MP4, MOV and WebM videos up to 150 MB. The file is attached with status
`ready`, and no presigned PUT or complete-media call is needed.
The post is always left in `draft`. A scheduled post is demoted to draft
and keeps its stored time; schedule it again with update-post. The body
accepts only `file` and `fileName`, and publishing parameters are rejected
with INVALID_MEDIA_FILE. The response has the update-post shape and does
not include the media ID, so read `media[]` from get-post. Each attempt that
reaches the download counts one URL against the media URL ingestion limit
of 60 URLs per hour, shared with `mediaUrls`; idempotent replays don't count.

parameters.description:
Recommended. Publora recognises a retry by the post ID, `file.file_id`
and the sanitized file name. `download_url` and `mime_type` are
excluded, so a retry with a refreshed temporary URL replays the
original response instead of attaching the file twice. Reusing the
key with a different post, file ID or file name returns 422. A failed
download frees the key for a retry with a fresh reference. Without a
key, every call attaches another copy. Keys are kept for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

file.description: File reference. A string is rejected, including a local path, base64 data or a bare URL.

download_url.description: HTTPS URL to download from; temporary signed URLs work. Same checks as mediaUrls: https only, no embedded credentials, port 443, no private or loopback hosts.

file_id.description: Stable file identifier; part of the idempotency fingerprint

file_name.description: Original file name; used when fileName is absent

mime_type.description: Hint only; the type is detected from the bytes

fileName.description:
Descriptive file name with an extension. Takes precedence over
`file.file_name`; if both are absent the name is `chatgpt-media`.
Only the last path segment is kept; it is trimmed, each run of
whitespace becomes `_`, and any character other than an ASCII
letter, digit, `_`, `.` or `-` is removed. A name that ends up
empty or only dots is rejected, including one taken from
`file.file_name`. get-post returns the result as
`media[].sourceFileName`.

scheduledTime.description: Only included when a scheduled time is stored

The stored scheduled time. A post demoted from scheduled keeps
its time while in draft; `null` when no time is stored.

idempotency key freed); a post that can no longer be edited
(POST_NOT_EDITABLE); or a YouTube target connection that is no longer
the caller's (INVALID_PLATFORM_CONNECTION, downloaded file discarded).

Create a post to be published across one or more social media platforms.
Supports text, images, and video (1 video per post).
The image count per post is platform-specific: Twitter/X, Bluesky, and
Mastodon allow up to 4; Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Telegram
allow up to 10; Threads allows up to 20. There is no separate
"carousel" field — a
carousel is formed implicitly by attaching multiple images to one
postGroupId (Instagram: 2-10 images = carousel, 1 image = single photo),
in upload order. See the Media Uploads guide for the full matrix.
If scheduledTime is provided, the post will be published at that time.
If omitted, the post is saved as a draft. Set publishNow=true to publish
immediately at server time.

parameters.description:
Opt-in idempotency. Omit the header for the previous behaviour —
every call creates a new post.

Send a unique value (a UUID is a good choice) per logical operation
to make retries safe:

- Same key + identical body, original request finished → the original
  status code and response body are replayed. No second post.
- Same key + identical body, original request still in flight → `409`
  (`IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT`). Retry shortly.
- Same key + different body → `422` (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT`).
  Nothing is created.

Keys are scoped to the API key's user, so they never collide across
accounts.
Records expire 24 hours after they are created; reusing a key after
that window is treated as a brand-new request.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

content.description: Normally required and non-empty. May be omitted or empty only when a targeted LinkedIn connection has repost intent via platformSettings.linkedin.repostEnabled=true or a non-empty repostParentUrn; repost validation still requires a valid parent/setting combination.

publishNow.description:
`true` publishes immediately. The server uses its current time as
scheduledTime, stores the post as `scheduled` and starts delivery at
once; the response does not wait for the platforms. The usual
connection, plan, content, media and first-comment validation applies.
Publish Now uses the monthly post allowance (`POST_LIMIT_REACHED`) but
takes no slot in the scheduled-post queue and ignores the schedule
horizon. Combining it with a future scheduledTime or `status: "draft"`
returns 400 `PUBLISH_NOW_CONFLICT`; a non-boolean value returns 400
`INVALID_PUBLISH_NOW`. Omitted or `false` keeps draft/schedule behavior.

time and a `SCHEDULED_TIME_COERCED` warning is returned — the
post is still created. Read the `scheduledTime` in the response
for the time actually stored.

Times less than 5 minutes in the past are always tolerated this
way. Strict rejection for a time 5 or more minutes in the past
is scheduled to begin on **2026-08-25**, unless production
configuration overrides that date. Before strict mode it is
clamped with a warning. Send a future time to avoid both.

plan entitlement, and adding a target to a scheduled post re-runs scheduling
quota and post validation.
platformSettings are merged per-platform with existing settings —
omitted fields are preserved.
Updating a post group also updates all associated platform-specific posts.
A content or platform edit is refused with POST_NOT_EDITABLE (400) or
POST_PUBLISH_IN_PROGRESS / POST_GROUP_VERSION_CONFLICT (409) rather than
partially applied.

parameters.description:
Opt-in idempotency. Omit the header for the previous behaviour —
every call applies the update again.

Send a unique value (a UUID is a good choice) per logical operation
to make retries safe:

- Same key + identical body, original request finished → the original
  status code and response body are replayed. The update is not
  re-applied.
- Same key + identical body, original request still in flight → `409`
  (`IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT`). Retry shortly.
- Same key + different body → `422` (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT`).
  Nothing is changed.

The key is bound to this `postGroupId` as well as the body, so the
same key reused against a different post counts as a different
request. Keys are scoped to the API key's user, so they never collide
across accounts.
Records expire 24 hours after they are created; reusing a key after
that window is treated as a brand-new request.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: At least one of publishNow, status, scheduledTime, content, platforms, platformSettings, firstComment, firstComments, or mediaUrls must be provided

content.description:
Replacement base post text. Every platform post without an explicit
per-account override is rewritten to this text; overrides created in
the web editor are preserved. Editing the text of a Twitter or Threads
target clears its derived thread split so it is recomputed.

An empty string is accepted while the post stays a draft. Scheduling
still enforces each platform's content and media rules.

firstComment.description:
Legacy single-comment replacement, or null to remove it.
Do not send with firstComments.

firstComments.description: Replace the ordered list; null or [] clears it. Do not send with firstComment.

mediaUrls.description: Public https URLs downloaded server-side and appended to existing media. Images: 25 MB each; videos: 150 MB each; aggregate: 300 MB. Ingestion is all-or-nothing.

platforms.description:
Replacement target set. The array REPLACES the stored one — it is not
merged, so send the complete final list. Use the exact connection IDs
returned by GET /platform-connections; duplicates are rejected with
INVALID_PLATFORMS and unknown/foreign IDs with INVALID_PLATFORM_CONNECTION.

IDs removed from the array have their platform posts deleted. An empty
array is accepted only while the post remains a draft; scheduling an
empty set returns PLATFORMS_REQUIRED.

publishNow.description:
`true` publishes this draft or scheduled post immediately at server
time, with the same checks as create-post. A scheduled post moved to
Publish Now frees its scheduled-queue slot and keeps its monthly
reservation when the month and targets are unchanged. Combining it
with a future scheduledTime or `status: "draft"` returns 400
`PUBLISH_NOW_CONFLICT`; a non-boolean value returns 400
`INVALID_PUBLISH_NOW`.

scheduledTime.description:
New ISO 8601 UTC scheduled time. Send a future time.

If the time is in the past, it is clamped to the current server
time and a `SCHEDULED_TIME_COERCED` warning is returned — the
update still succeeds. Read the `scheduledTime` in the response
for the time actually stored.

Times less than 5 minutes in the past are always tolerated this
way. Strict rejection for a time 5 or more minutes in the past
is scheduled to begin on **2026-08-25**, unless production
configuration overrides that date. Before strict mode it is
clamped with a warning.

The same check applies to the post's existing scheduledTime when
you move a post to `status: "scheduled"` without sending a new
time — a long-stale draft can therefore be rejected.

content.description:
The effective base text stored after the update. Always
present; an empty string when the post has no base text.

platforms.description:
The effective target set stored after the update. Always
present; an empty array for a draft with no targets.

scheduledTime.description:
Only included if the post has a scheduled time. Duplicates
the top-level `scheduledTime`, which is always present and
is the preferred field to read.

The effective scheduled time that was actually stored. Always
present. `null` when the post has no scheduled time (e.g. it
was moved back to draft). This may differ from the value you
sent — if so, a `SCHEDULED_TIME_COERCED` warning explains
why. Trust this field over your requested value.
